evals.expected_output: Chooses the scoped MCP lane, establishes repository authority and permissions, delegates with measurable criteria, then independently verifies without pushing or deploying.

evals.prompt: 用 ChatGPT Pro 做一個可玩的 Angry Birds 網頁版，滑鼠與觸控都能拉弓，完成後在本機瀏覽器測到真的能玩。
